name: InitObjectPool
evidence: slot 0 of the 0x8C class: after InitObject sets four ids to -1, zeroes its blocks, sets defaults (5.0, 20000.0) and schedules func_001A8208 (SpawnObjectPoolCopies) with func_001DBCC8

name: UnregisterObjectPool
evidence: slot 7 of the 0x8C class: runs the base func_00182ED0, then clears the chosen item through func_001A93C8

name: GetObjectPoolShare
evidence: creates the 0x20-byte shared record at 0x3C on first use, points its first word back at the pool, and returns it

name: AddObjectPoolEntry
evidence: allocates the 0x50-byte entry array on first use and appends a 0x14-byte entry with an id, a count and two flag bits

name: SpawnObjectPoolCopies
evidence: for each entry looks its object up in the world (list 4), makes copies up to the entry's count, runs their set-up slots and stores them in the entry's list

name: CopyObjectPool
evidence: slot 9 of the 0x8C class: runs func_001830D8, then either shares the source's record (marking it lent and linking itself in its list) or duplicates the source's entry array

name: StartObjectPool
evidence: slot 16 of the 0x8C class: runs func_00182C58 and once looks up the ids at 0x4C, 0x50, 0x54 and 0x58, filing each object found by its kind (0x7E, 0x73, 2, 0x75) in the pool's fields

name: ClearObjectPoolChoiceIfFlag
evidence: slot 20 of the 0x8C class: when the flag argument is set, clears the chosen item through func_001A93C8

name: FindObjectPoolEntry
evidence: returns the 0x14-byte entry whose key equals the argument, or 0

name: EnableObjectPoolEntry
evidence: sets bit 2 of the flags of the entry found by key

name: DisableObjectPoolEntry
evidence: clears bit 2 of the flags of the entry found by key

name: SetObjectPoolEntryCount
evidence: stores a value, limited to the entry's stored-copy count, in the count word of the entry found by key

name: IsObjectInPool
evidence: finds the pool row whose first object has the query's id (+8) and returns 1 when the query is one of that row's objects; the agents' and the player-linked collider's contact and target tests call it

name: IsObjectPoolItemFree
evidence: returns 0 when another pool of the shared group holds the item as its chosen one, or the item is registered, a kind 0x3B object with word 0x678 clear, or a kind 0x20 object with word 0x680 set

name: AdvanceObjectPoolEntry
evidence: starting after the current entry index at 0x44, moves it to the next enabled entry with at least one free item

name: ChooseObjectPoolItem
evidence: in the current enabled entry picks the first free item, stores it at 0x48 and removes it from the entry unless flag bit 1 is set

name: HasObjectPoolChoice
evidence: returns 1 if an item is chosen at 0x48, else runs ChooseObjectPoolItem and returns whether it chose one

name: LaunchChosenPoolObject
evidence: takes the pool's chosen object (ChooseObjectPoolItem when none), places it at the placement record's transform aimed along the follower point (FrameFollower), sets its velocity from the mover or the heading and the fitted speed through descriptor slots, and starts it

name: ClearObjectPoolChoice
evidence: zeroes the chosen item at 0x48 and, if the shared record is lent, its word at 0x10

name: ResetPlacementRecord
evidence: zeroes the 0x80-byte placement record at +0x60 of an object (an object pool, the object object_host_functions sets up) and sets its rotation (+0x20) to the identity matrix

name: ResetObjectPoolReleaseRecord
evidence: zeroes the 0x70 bytes at +0xE0 of an object pool and sets the vector at +0x110 to (0, 1, 0), +0x120 to 0 and +0x124 to 20000.0, as InitObjectPool does; the script host function func_00106B10 calls it, as ResetScriptPlacementRecord calls ResetPlacementRecord for +0x60

name: ClearObjectPoolHeadingRecord
evidence: zeroes the 0x18 bytes at +0x150 of an object pool, as InitObjectPool does; the script host function func_00106BB0 calls it

name: GetPlacementRecordTransform
evidence: gives the position and rotation a placement record names: through its frame object (+0x0, ConvertPositionToWorld), its object (+0x4, world position and rotation), its collider (+0x8, +0x140 and +0x110) or its own values (+0x10, +0x20)

name: ComputeFrameFollowerPoint
evidence: a point in an object's frame (or the anchor's): mode 0 transforms it directly, modes 1 and 2 evaluate the object's frame at a time from a quadratic of the distance to the target clamped to a range and write the point in the destination frame

name: GetPlacementRecordAngle
evidence: gives the heading a placement record names: the angle of its object's world rotation (+0x10) or its collider's (+0x14), else its own angle at +0x8

name: GetPlacementRecordPitch
evidence: the pitch of the record's object (+0x10) as atan2 of its rotation row's z over its length in x and y, else the stored pitch at +0x4; the counterpart of GetPlacementRecordAngle

name: StartGaugeBarAgent
evidence: slot 16 of class 0x0D: runs StartAgent, then registers itself with its world through func_001DDC38

name: IsGaugeBarAgentFree
evidence: slot 0x16C of class 0x0D (as IsGaugeAgentFree): returns 0 when func_001DDA80 holds for its world, else its flag at +0xC24

name: UpdateGaugeBarAgentGoal
evidence: slot 94 of class 0x0D: runs UpdateAgentGoal and in state 0x10 heads for the position (+0x140) of the object its slot 102 returns

name: UpdateGaugeBarAgentState
evidence: slot 90 of class 0x0D: runs UpdateAgentState, then func_001C8BC0 in state 0x10

name: EnterGaugeBarAgentState
evidence: slot 92 of class 0x0D: runs EnterAgentState and on state 0xB marks level part 4 done (MarkLevelDone) and starts a memory card save

name: UpdateGaugeBarAgent
evidence: slot 17 of class 0x0D: runs UpdateAgent, then stops and clears the animation player at 0xC20 once its value at +0x18 is 0

name: UpdateGaugeBarAgentVisibility
evidence: slot 46 of class 0x0D: shows g_gaugeBarElement while AreMenusAndFadeClear, else hides it

name: HandleGaugeBarAgentObjectEvent
evidence: slot 0xC4 (object event) of class 0x0D: counts at 0xC10 and lowers the gauge (DecrementGaugeCount), sends its member group 0xB00 a message (slot 27) and plays a clip (ReplaceAnimationPlayer) on the events it handles, then runs HandleAgentObjectEvent

name: SetGaugeBarAgentValues
evidence: stores its three arguments in the words 0xC14, 0xC18 and 0xC1C of a class 0x0D agent

name: InstallScreenElements
evidence: stores each of the 37 element tables in its global element, calls slot 0 on every element of D_002486B0 and resets D_00275F80

name: InitScreenElements
evidence: calls slot 1 on each of the 37 elements of D_002486B0 from the last to the first

name: UpdateScreenElements
evidence: calls slot 2 on each of the 37 elements from the last to the first, then advances the screen fade g_screenFade

name: HideScreenElements
evidence: calls slot 16 with mode 0 on each of the 37 elements

name: ResetScreenElements
evidence: calls slot 5 on each of the 37 elements

name: QueueEachScreenElementDraw
evidence: runs slot 10 (+0x28) of each of the 37 screen elements of g_screenElements whose mode is set, when it has one; QueueScreenElementDraws calls it

name: DrawScreenElements
evidence: calls slot 9 on each element of D_002486B0 whose mode is not 0, then draws g_screenFade and D_00273EB0

name: InitScreenElement
evidence: slot 0 of the element tables: picks its 20-byte placement record from D_0026C3E0 by index, sets the slide times to 0.25, installs the default clock, places it and starts it hidden
